purpose: Bounded finite measured tests requested by M6 Pass C (+Necromancy -Persist versus two-mana nonlegendary Auton recursion and two-mana Goryo's Vengeance haste burst; Seize the Day) plus Lightning Greaves vs Swiftfoot Boots self-targeting, Bojuka Bog vs Malakir Rebirth, and the deployment cost of the selected swaps and staged alternatives. Seeded goldfish deployment model and exhaustive rules-encoded scenario grids; not a game simulation, not a source-bound game-engine receipt and not a win rate.

B1_recursion_Persist_vs_Necromancy_vs_Go.notes: Frozen-cache Oracle: Persist returns target NONLEGENDARY creature card from YOUR graveyard (sorcery, -1/-1 counter), so it can never return Lord Xander, Tergrid, Karlach or Bruvac. Necromancy ({2}{B}, castable as though it had flash) returns a creature card from ANY graveyard; cast off sorcery timing it is sacrificed at the next cleanup step, its leaves trigger sacrifices the creature, so an end-step Necromancy on Lord Xander yields the enters (discard half) AND a second dies (sacrifice half) trigger. Goryo's Vengeance returns only a legendary card from your graveyard with haste, exiled (not dies) at the next end step. Commander replacement: Lord Xander must have been put into the graveyard (owner's choice) to be a target. Unweighted cells, not frequencies.

B2_haste_equipment_Greaves_vs_Boots.notes: Lightning Greaves: haste and shroud, Equip {0}. Swiftfoot Boots: haste and hexproof, Equip {1}. Equip, Saw in Half, Molten Duplication, Feign Death and Malakir Rebirth all target; shroud stops your own targeting, hexproof stops only opponents. With Greaves on Lord Xander you can enable the action only by moving Greaves to another creature you control (Equip {0}, sorcery speed), which strips Xander's protection and is impossible for instant-speed responses with no other creature (encoded conservatively as allowed when another creature exists). Boots costs 1 more to grant haste the turn Xander is cast (spare 0 cells). Phantasmal Image copies are sacrificed if either is equipped to them.

B3_land_slot_Bojuka_Bog_vs_Malakir_Rebir.notes: Malakir Rebirth ({B} instant, lose 2 life): target creature gains 'when this dies, return it to the battlefield tapped' until end of turn; its back face Malakir Mire enters tapped for {B}, same as Bojuka Bog. Graveyard-hate loss (Bog_only cells) is the disclosed cost; the deck keeps no other repeatable graveyard hate (Tergrid's Lantern is not hate). Xander dying must be routed to the graveyard (decline the command-zone replacement) for the return.
